title: Chapter 416 - 416 The Selection Of Professors!

Chapter 416 - 416 The Selection Of Professors!

Chapter 416 - 416 The Selection of Professors!

416 The Selection of Professors!

Generally speaking, the selection of professors, especially the selection of full professors, required a long review.

However, an hour after Lin Fan agreed to take in students, the official website of Jiangbei University announced that Lin Fan had become a full professor.

Then, there was news that Lin Fan would be teaching students.

A single stone stirred up a thousand ripples!

Countless people started a heated discussion.

Man in the Wind: [Heavens! Is God Lin Fan finally going to recruit students? I’m excited!]

Blind: [I’m a student from Huaqing University asking how to apply for Master Lin Fan’s postgraduate studies.]

Teng Yongsheng: [I’m a student at Capital University. I beg God Lin Fan to take me in.]

Likes Chuzheng: [Isn’t Lin Fan a professor at Jiangbei University? The students from Huaqing University and Capital University are going to study under Lin Fan?]

Legend of Night Shift: [Huaqing University? Capital University? Let me ask you, has anyone from Huaqing University and Capital University solved several math problems? Has anyone from Huaqing University and Capital University invented earthquake prediction devices, carbon-based photoengraving machines, super batteries, and human islet recovery medicines? I can only say that God Lin Fan is awesome!]

…

According to Shen Liang’s initial plan, he wanted Lin Fan to teach all the students from Jiangbei University.

After all, the treasures should be kept within the circle.

However, as the news spread on the internet, the leaders of Huaqing University, Capital University, and Modu University all made requests to Jiangbei University.

Shen Liang could only make a concession.

After discussing it with Lin Fan, he posted an email address.

Students who wanted to apply to become Lin Fan’s students should send an email to that address.

…

When Lin Fan arrived at the classroom, Song Yi asked, “Brother Lin Fan, you’ve become a professor in our school?”

“Yes,” Lin Fan replied casually.

When the students in the classroom heard it, they all cast him envious gazes.

Lin Fan first solved a few difficult problems and then invented a high-tech product.

Now, he had even become a professor!

They both received nine years of compulsory education, but why was he so outstanding?

Lin Fan said, “I might have less time to come to classes in the future.”

After all, he was about to become a teacher.

He could not completely ignore his students.

Otherwise, how could he complete the mission?

“Brother Lin Fan, let’s have dinner together tonight.”

“Yes, let’s eat together!” Ma Zhong also said.

Immediately after, all the students in the class followed suit.

Lin Fan smiled. “What are you guys doing? It’s not like I’m not coming to classes anymore. Even if I don’t come, we’re still classmates!

“But, of course, it’s not a problem to have dinner together tonight! Just take it as a celebration of my becoming a professor. Where do you want to eat?”

In the past, all the students liked to go to AC Clubhouse.

However, today, they went to a barbecue stall near the school.

Eating skewers and drinking beer was a different experience.

All the students picked up bottles of beer and toasted Lin Fan. The atmosphere was extremely lively.

That night, Lin Fan stayed in his dorm to sleep.

…

While Lin Fan was eating and sleeping…

In the female dormitory, Xia Bing and Xia Xue stared at the form on the screen and looked back and forth several times.

They constantly modified and reviewed every word.

However, they were still a little worried.

At this moment, Zhao Ni, who had just washed her hair, slowly walked over and asked, “What are you two doing?”

As she spoke, she leaned her head over.

“This is… an application form? You guys want to be God Lin Fan’s students?”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue nodded hard.

They thought for a moment and said, “You… Can you help me check?”

“Ah… Alright,” Zhao Ni replied.

After a while, she said, “Well written! Perfect!”

Xia Bing and Xia Xue nodded, but they still did not immediately send the form.

Instead, they started checking again from the beginning to the end.

They removed spaces, changed tables, added or removed words…

After a long time, they put the form into the email.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue moved their mouse and stopped for a long time under the send button…

In the end, they finally pressed send.

Suddenly, Xia Bing and Xia Xue’s hearts were beating wildly like drums, and their two pretty faces turned red.

Then, they sat in front of the computer and quietly looked at their empty mailbox.

…

For the next few days, Lin Fan stayed in school. He went to class as usual.

After all…

Just as Lin Fan had said, he might not have as much time to go to class for the next period of time.

It was time to experience the life of a student to the best of his ability now.

In the blink of an eye, it was the weekend.

Last night, Lin Fan returned to Coiling Dragon Villa.

Lin Fan had been eating in the canteen for the past few days.

Today, his meal was replaced with M5 beef, Japanese eel, duck breast liver roll, matsutake egg tart, caviar cake, and other delicacies from a Michelin two-star restaurant.

After eating his fill, Lin Fan casually swiped his phone.

At this moment, he seemed to have thought of something. He slowly walked to the computer and logged into his email.

Instantly, tens of thousands of emails appeared on the screen.

Among them, there were students from Jiangbei University, Huaqing University, and Capital University… There were also many students from foreign universities.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but mumble, “Aren’t there too many?”

Although Lin Fan had the scanning ability and could read these emails in an instant, in the face of thousands of emails, he still felt his scalp go numb.

After all, it was very troublesome to click thousands of times with the mouse.

After a while, Lin Fan raised the super smart watch on his wrist and called out, “Lil White!”

“I’m here, Master!”

The super smart watch flickered slightly and let out a crisp sound.

“Can you help me sort and select these emails?” Lin Fan said.

“Of course, Master.” Lil White asked, “May I ask what kind of requirements you have for your candidates?”

Lin Fan thought for a moment and said, “No foreigners!”

Instantly, Lin Fan’s mailbox lost about a quarter of the emails.

Lin Fan continued, “Outstanding talents from the fields of chemistry, computer science, mathematics, physics, and biology. Pick ten from each field with the most potential.”

“Yes, Master!” Lil White said.

Soon, there were only 50 emails left.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan picked up his mouse and opened one email after another.

He either nodded, shook his head, or pondered…

When Lin Fan opened the tenth email, he could not help but mutter, “Nie Zhenjiang of Huaqing University? He also participated in the International Mathematical Modeling Competition with me, right?

“He’s an old acquaintance.”

As he spoke, he opened the next email.

“Xia Bing?”
